sequencing_basis: Explicit owner instruction: accept all 3D assets and laboratory layout/scenes before developing manipulation steps.
allowed_current_work: Research exact device and robot resources
Evaluate static access, opening sweeps and full-body spatial envelopes
Prepare safety/design evidence and owner review package
deferred_work: New grasping, assembly or full-task execution episodes
existing_task_definitions_role: Input requirements for assets, interfaces and necessary equipment states during scene development.

clearance_policy.decision_rule: Derive usable space from whole robot/hand/load sweeps, device openings, uncertainty, manufacturer requirements and any applicable site constraints.

gates.requirement: Complete resource decomposition and instance allocation
Asset source, identity, scale, structure, appearance and rights review
Dimensioned layout, equipment states and service/support requirements
Whole humanoid, hand and carried-load spatial envelope checks
Risk register, controls, manufacturer requirements and site applicability
Exact-revision interactive scene and comparison evidence
Owner acceptance of assets and laboratory scenes

scope: Asset/scene design acceptance. Does not grant manipulation execution, dynamic robot safety or physical site certification.
implementation: Workflow contract for this pilot; no runtime launcher interlock is implemented by this JSON.
